feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 October 2026 7:31am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 11 October 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind later.


##Synopsis##

Weak ridge of high pressure over Ireland, transferring eastwards and declining. Complex area of low pressure in the mid Atlantic, associated frontal troughs moving into the British Isles tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or northwest 2 to 4, becoming variable 3 or less this morning, settling southeast 3 or 4 during the afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 this evening, then further increasing 5 or 6 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming smooth or slight this morning, then slight or moderate again later this evening and tonight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then spells of rain or drizzle spreading from the southwest tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 5 or 6, imminently veering south or south-southwest 4 or 5, soon increasing 5 or 6, then veering southwest 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle, with areas of mist developing and the risk of fog patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor, but very poor in any fog patches.
